name: icloud-photo-curator
description: Curate iCloud Photos with client-native vision, local proposals, and gated album writes.
long_description: Connects iCloud Photos to Claude Desktop through a local MCP server. It reads albums and metadata, returns photos as MCP image blocks so the connected model sorts by visible content (food, documents, landscapes), resolves GPS to a place name offline for location albums, and saves album proposals locally. Album creation and adding photos to albums are an experimental, gated, dry-run-by-default feature. The plugin never deletes photos.

apple_id.title: Apple ID email (optional)
apple_id.description: Your iCloud Apple ID. You can also leave this blank and set it during the one-time `try_curator.py login`. Your password is never stored here; it goes into the OS keychain.
